thread:
Asha: Heads up — I pulled together last week's CS touchpoints into a tiny priority strawman for product. 9 distinct asks, roughly 3 look like renewal-risk drivers. Sharing scoring + quick extracts below. Need PM + product input by EOD Fri. cc @Tom @Priya :calendar:
Tom: 👍 thanks. can you paste the scoring rubric here so we can sanity-check thresholds?
Asha: Yep — super small:
```
Fields: Impact (1-5), Effort (1-5), RenewalRisk (0-3), OnboardFriction (0-2)
Score = Impact*2 - Effort + RenewalRisk*3 + OnboardFriction*1
Priority: High if score >= 8, Medium 5-7, Low <5
```
Priya: Good start. can we add PlatformCost (-1..1) to slightly penalize infra-heavy items? low-cost front-end fixes shouldn't get drowned out.
Zoe: :eyes: From onboarding calls — two recurrent asks: "per-route quota visibility in console" and "sample prompt library + templates". both low effort from eng notes, but big CS time-savers.
Raj: Do we have canonical tickets or customer threads to attach? I'll link to roadmap epic if so.
Asha: Quick extract (from notes) — pasted IDs are internal psuedo-ids for now:
```
1) PID-451 — Sample Prompt Library
   Impact:5 Effort:2 RenewalRisk:1 OnboardFriction:2 PlatformCost:0 => Score = 5*2 -2 +1*3 +2 = 13 (High)
2) PID-472 — Per-route quotas visibility (console)
   Impact:4 Effort:3 RenewalRisk:2 OnboardFriction:2 PlatformCost:-1 => Score = 4*2 -3 +2*3 +2 -1 = 13 (High)
3) PID-489 — Batch-ingest improvements (backend)
   Impact:3 Effort:5 RenewalRisk:1 OnboardFriction:0 PlatformCost:-1 => Score = 3*2 -5 +1*3 +0 -1 = 3 (Low)
```
Zoe: +1 to prompt library — we already see NPS lift when we demo quick templates in onboarding.
Tom: If RenewalRisk >=2 we should fast-track a small eng spike. Can eng/ops estimate infra uplift for PID-472?
Priya: I'll add PlatformCost into the shared sheet and mark estimates as TBD. also propose we do a tiny canary for the prompt library (feature flag + 10% of new signups).
feedback-bot: Reminder: add feedback items to the "product-feedback" board: /feedback create "CS: PID-451 Sample prompts"
Asha: :thumbsup: I'll upload the sheet (will share link in #cs-docs), create the GH issues, and tag product-ops. Plan: review this on Wed sync, call for decisions by Fri.
Raj: I'll create roadmap issues and ping @product-ops + link customer threads. if anyone wants to split ownership on PID-472, assign me for infra liaison.
Tom: Sounds good. thanks Asha — adding to Wed agenda.
